outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS A LARGE AREA EXTENDING FROM THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES NORTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO SOUTHERN MICHIGAN. THE GREATEST THREAT OF TORNADOES AND VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE CENTERED OVER NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI AND ALABAMA INTO TENNESSEE AND SOUTHERN KENTUCKY. MORE ISOLATED SEVERE STORMS ARE POSSIBLE DURING THE EVENING INTO THE WESTERN CAROLINAS...AND FRIDAY MORNING ALONG THE CENTRAL GULF COAST.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A BROAD BELT OF SWLY FLOW ALOFT WILL STRETCH FROM NRN MEXICO ACROSS MUCH OF THE ERN STATES WITH LEADING SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND ASSOCIATED 100 KT MIDLEVEL SPEED MAX MOVING FROM THE MID MS VALLEY INTO THE GREAT LAKES. A SECONDARY UPPER LEVEL JET WILL ALSO BE PRESENT FARTHER S FROM TX ACROSS THE CNTRL GULF COAST. AT THE SURFACE...LOW PRESSURE WILL MOVE FROM NRN IL INTO LOWER MI WITH A STALLING FRONT EXTENDING SWWD ACROSS IL AND INTO ERN TX BY LATE AFTERNOON. AHEAD OF THIS FRONT...STRONG SLY LOW-LEVEL FLOW WILL MAINTAIN A NWD FLUX OF MOISTURE WITH 60 F DEWPOINTS TO THE OH RIVER...AND MID TO UPPER 60S F TO THE S. THE COMBINATION OF A VERY MOIST AND UNSTABLE AIR MASS WITH COOL TEMPERATURES ALOFT...ALONG WITH AMPLE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR WILL BE PRESENT OVER A LARGE AREA AND WILL SUPPORT SEVERE STORMS. HOWEVER...THE FORECAST IS RELATIVELY COMPLEX OWING TO EARLY DAY RAIN AND STORMS...AS WELL AS SUBTLE FORCING FOR ASCENT ESPECIALLY ACROSS SRN AREAS. THAT SAID...A CONDITIONAL THREAT OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND PERHAPS A COUPLE STRONG TORNADOES DOES EXIST DURING THE AFTERNOON AND EVENING OVER THE ENHANCED RISK AREA...WITH MORE OF AN ISOLATED RISK PERIPHERALLY.

sections.title: SRN AND ERN IL...IND...KY
sections.text: A BROKEN LINE OF STORMS IS EXPECTED TO FORM RELATIVELY EARLY IN THE DAY...BY AROUND 18Z...FROM THE SFC LOW IN NRN IL SWD TO THE OH RIVER. WIND FIELDS WILL BE EXTREMELY STRONG WITH OVER 50 KTS AT 700 MB. ONLY MARGINAL LOW-LEVEL SRH VALUES ARE EXPECTED TO BE PRESENT OWING TO VEERING WINDS WITH TIME...HOWEVER...LOW-LEVEL BUOYANCY SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT FOR SCATTERED SEVERE STORMS WITH LONG HODOGRAPHS SUPPORTING HAIL. AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT GIVEN FAVORABLE CELLULAR STORM MODE AS WELL...BUT FAST-MOVING SPLITTING CELLS SEEM PROBABLE. A FEW DAMAGING WIND GUSTS ARE ALSO EXPECTED GIVEN VERY FAST STORM MOTIONS AND OUTFLOW. ...ERN AR/NRN LA EWD ACROSS TN...CNTRL AND NRN MS/AL...SRN APPALACHIANS... A COMPLICATED FORECAST SCENARIO WILL UNFOLD TODAY...BEGINNING WITH A BATCH OF RAIN AND STORMS EARLY IN THE MORNING ACROSS MUCH OF NRN MS AND WRN AL. THIS ACTIVITY IS EXPECTED TO SHIFT EWD DURING THE DAY OVER AL AND NRN GA....SUPPORTED BY DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION AND A STRONG SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET. THUS...SOME OF THIS ACTIVITY MAY BECOME SEVERE WITH DAMAGING WINDS AND/OR AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. IN THE WAKE OF THIS ACTIVITY...STRONG HEATING WILL OCCUR OVER THE MID TO LOWER MS VALLEY REG

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS A LARGE AREA EXTENDING FROM THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES NORTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO SOUTHERN MICHIGAN. THE GREATEST THREAT FOR TORNADOES AND VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE CENTERED OVER NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI AND ALABAMA INTO TENNESSEE AND SOUTHERN KENTUCKY. THESE STORMS SHOULD SPREAD INTO THE WESTERN CAROLINAS DURING THE EVENING...WHILE ADDITIONAL SCATTERED STORMS MAY DEVELOP OVERNIGHT/FRIDAY MORNING ALONG THE CENTRAL GULF COAST REGION.

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: A LARGE/POSITIVELY TILTED UPPER TROUGH WILL CONTINUE TO ENCOMPASS ALL BUT THE WRN U.S. THIS PERIOD...WHERE HIGH-AMPLITUDE RIDGING IS FORECAST TO BUILD ACROSS THE WRN NOAM COAST. THE TROUGH WILL MAKE GRADUAL EWD PROGRESS WITH TIME...MAINTAINING A STRONG POSITIVE TILT THROUGH THE PERIOD AND THUS A BROAD BELT OF STRONG SWLY/WSWLY FLOW FROM TX NEWD ACROSS THE MS AND OH VALLEYS AND INTO THE GREAT LAKES. AT THE SURFACE...A LOW CURRENTLY ANALYZED INVOF ERN IA IS FORECAST TO ADVANCE NEWD ACROSS THE SRN UPPER GREAT LAKES REGION...ALONG A WARM FRONT WHICH NOW EXTENDS ACROSS NRN IL/SRN LK MI INTO LOWER MI. THE TRAILING COLD FRONT -- CURRENTLY EXTENDING FROM THE IA LOW SWD ACROSS MO/ERN OK AND INTO ERN/SRN TX -- WILL ALSO MAKE GRADUAL EWD PROGRESS...EXTENDING FROM THE LOWER GREAT LAKES SWWD ACROSS THE TN VALLEY TO THE WRN GULF COASTAL REGION BY THE END OF THE PERIOD FRIDAY AM. AREAS ALONG AND AHEAD OF THIS FRONT AND GENERALLY W OF THE APPALACHIANS WILL BE THE FOCUS FOR THUNDERSTORMS/SEVERE WEATHER THIS PERIOD. ...SRN LOWER MI SWD ACROSS THE OH AND TN VALLEYS INTO THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES/LOWER MS VALLEY... A COMPLEX CONVECTIVE/SEVERE WEATHER SCENARIO IS UNFOLDING TODAY ACROSS AREAS NEAR A

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS ARE POSSIBLE ACROSS A LARGE AREA EXTENDING FROM THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES NORTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO SOUTHERN MICHIGAN. THE GREATEST THREAT FOR TORNADOES AND VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE CENTERED OVER NORTHERN MISSISSIPPI AND ALABAMA THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING.

sections.title: MID SOUTH REGION THIS AFTERNOON/EVENING
sections.text: ONGOING CONVECTION HAS REINFORCED AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY ACROSS NW AL AND NRN MS...WHILE CLOUD STREETS ARE ALREADY DEVELOPING IN THE UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR TO SW ACROSS NRN LA. THE PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ACROSS NRN LA /ALSO REFLECTED IN 12Z 850 MB ANALYSES/ SHOULD SERVE AS THE INITIATION ZONE FOR SEVERE STORMS BY EARLY AFTERNOON...WITH STORMS SPREADING ENEWD THROUGH THE AFTERNOON/EVENING. THE WARM SECTOR ENVIRONMENT WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS CAPABLE OF VERY LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS...GIVEN MLCAPE NEAR 2000 J/KG AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR NEAR 50 KT. THOUGH LOW-LEVEL FLOW/SHEAR WILL TEND TO WEAKEN ACROSS THE MID SOUTH AS THE SYNOPTIC WAVE MOVES NEWD OVER THE GREAT LAKES REGION...LOCALLY BACKED WINDS ALONG THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WILL HELP FOCUS THE TORNADO THREAT FROM NRN MS INTO NW AL THIS AFTERNOON. A STRONG TORNADO OR TWO WILL BE POSSIBLE AS SUPERCELLS INTERACT WITH THE REMNANT OUTFLOW BOUNDARY WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL BE ENHANCED.

sections.title: NE AR/WRN TN/WRN KY THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: CONVECTION IS ONGOING ACROSS E CENTRAL/NE AR JUST AHEAD OF THE SURFACE COLD FRONT. SOME DESTABILIZATION IS OCCURRING INTO WRN TN/KY TO THE N OF THE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY IN NRN MS...AND IT APPEARS THAT THIS CONVECTION WILL POSE A SEVERE RISK INTO THIS AFTERNOON. PRIMARILY STRAIGHT HODOGRAPHS SUGGEST THAT LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS...THOUGH AN ISOLATED TORNADO CANNOT BE RULED OUT. THE TIMING OF STORM DEVELOPMENT LATE THIS MORNING CASTS DOUBT ON WHETHER OR NOT THE BOUNDARY LAYER CAN RECOVER THIS AFTERNOON...WHICH MAY LIMIT THE POTENTIAL FOR ADDITIONAL SEVERE STORMS ALONG THE COLD FRONT TOWARD THE CONFLUENCE OF THE MS/OH RIVERS.

sections.title: SRN AL THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: A SMALL SUPERCELL CLUSTER IS ONGOING IN SW AL...ON THE N EDGE OF THE RICHEST RETURNING MOISTURE AND IN ASSOCIATION WITH THE SRN LOBE OF A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH NEAR THE MS/AL BORDER. VERTICAL SHEAR AND BUOYANCY SHOULD REMAIN SUFFICIENT TO MAINTAIN THE RISK FOR LARGE HAIL...DAMAGING WINDS...AND A TORNADO OR TWO WITH THE CLUSTER AS IT DEVELOPS EWD ALONG A DIFFERENTIAL HEATING ZONE ACROSS SRN AL.

sections.title: IL/INDIANA THIS AFTERNOON
sections.text: STORMS HAVE ALREADY DEVELOPED NEAR THE SURFACE CYCLONE AND NW EDGE OF THE WEAKLY UNSTABLE WARM SECTOR INTO NW IL. THIS CONVECTION WILL MOVE QUICKLY EWD ACROSS NRN IL BY EARLY AFTERNOON...WITH SOME ADDITIONAL SWD DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE ALONG THE SURFACE COLD FRONT INTO E CENTRAL IL AND INDIANA. A FEW DAMAGING GUSTS AND LARGE HAIL WILL BE THE MAIN THREATS. ..THOMPSON/GLEASON.. 03/31/2016

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT WILL PERSIST THIS AFTERNOON FROM THE CENTRAL GULF COAST STATES NORTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY TO SOUTHERN MICHIGAN. GREATEST THREAT FOR VERY LARGE HAIL WILL BE OVER PARTS OF THE LOWER MISSISSIPPI VALLEY INTO WESTERN TENNESSEE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING. GREATEST TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED OVER A PORTION OF MISSISSIPPI INTO WESTERN TENNESSEE THIS AFTERNOON AND EVENING THEN SHIFTING INTO ALABAMA THIS EVENING INTO TONIGHT.

sections.title: LOWER MS VALLEY THROUGH WRN TN
sections.text: PRIMARY CHANGE TO THIS PORTION OF THE OUTLOOK HAS BEEN TO SHIFT THE HIGHER TORNADO PROBABILITIES FARTHER NORTH INTO NRN MISSISSIPPI AND WESTERN TN WHERE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR IS SOMEWHAT GREATER IN VICINITY OF ERODING OUTFLOW BOUNDARY. OTHERWISE FORECAST APPEARS ON TRACK WITH NUMEROUS SUPERCELLS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE IN WARM SECTOR POSING A RISK FOR VERY LARGE HAIL THIS AFTERNOON.

sections.title: OH VALLEY AND GREAT LAKES REGION
sections.text: STORMS CONTINUE DEVELOPING IN PRE-FRONTAL CONFLUENCE ZONE WHERE A NARROW CORRIDOR OF MARGINAL INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED IN WARM SECTOR. THIS ACTIVITY IS EMBEDDED WITHIN A STRONG SHEAR ENVIRONMENT WITH POTENTIAL FOR BOWING SEGMENTS AND A FEW SUPERCELLS. SEVERE THREAT IN THIS REGION SHOULD DIMINISH AFTER 00Z AS THE BOUNDARY LAYER BEGINS TO STABILIZE. ..DIAL.. 03/31/2016 .PREV DISCUSSION... /ISSUED 1129 AM CDT THU MAR 31 2016/

outlooks.summary: SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS CAPABLE OF TORNADOES...LARGE HAIL...AND DAMAGING WINDS REMAIN POSSIBLE ACROSS EASTERN MISSISSIPPI...CENTRAL AND NORTHERN ALABAMA...AND SOUTHERN TENNESSEE. SEVERE WIND IS ALSO POSSIBLE ACROSS MUCH OF WESTERN GEORGIA THIS EVENING. ISOLATED SEVERE HAIL OR WIND IS ALSO POSSIBLE NORTHWARD ACROSS THE OHIO VALLEY.

sections.title: MS...AL...SRN TN...NRN LA...SRN AND WRN GA
sections.text: NUMEROUS THUNDERSTORMS REMAIN ONGOING AS OF 0100Z ACROSS ERN MS...MUCH OF AL...SRN TN...AND SWRN GA. 00Z SOUNDINGS AND VAD WIND PROFILES INDICATE STRONG SHEAR SUPPORTIVE OF SUPERCELLS AND TORNADOES. STORMS E OF THE JACKSON AREA HAVE MERGED INTO A COMPLEX AND MAY POSE A DAMAGING WIND THREAT IN ADDITION TO HAIL AND EVEN A BRIEF TORNADO. OTHER CELLS OVER NRN AL AND SRN TN NEAR THE AL LINE HAVE SHOWN STRONG ROTATION AND TORNADIC SIGNATURES AT TIMES. AS THE EVENING PROGRESSES...STORMS MAY EVENTUALLY MERGE AND PRODUCE MORE OF A DAMAGING WIND THREAT AS THEY TRAVEL EWD ACROSS AL AND INTO GA. HOWEVER...A PERSISTENT SWLY LOW-LEVEL JET AND AMPLE LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WILL STILL MAINTAIN AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT...EVEN IF EMBEDDED WITHIN A LINE. FOR MORE INFORMATION SEE MCD 0317.

sections.title: KY...SRN IND..OH
sections.text: SCATTERED STORMS REMAIN ONGOING ALONG THE COLD FRONT...FROM SRN IL ACROSS SRN INDIANA AND INTO SWRN OH. THESE STORMS...ALTHOUGH HIGHLY SHEARED PARALLEL TO THE FRONT...ARE IN A REGION OF RELATIVELY WEAKER INSTABILITY. THE 00Z ILN SOUNDING CONFIRMS MINIMAL CAPE AND STRONG WIND SHEAR. GIVEN LOSS OF HEATING...ONLY ISOLATED SEVERE WIND OR HAIL IS EXPECTED THIS EVENING WITH A GENERAL WEAKENING TREND INTO THE EVENING. LOCALLY STRONG WIND GUSTS AND/OR SMALL HAIL IS POSSIBLE. ..JEWELL.. 04/01/2016

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT AND POTENTIAL FOR DAMAGING WINDS OR HAIL ARE CONFINED TO THE SOUTHEAST PORTION OF WW 66 FROM MARION AND PEARL RIVER COUNTIES TO FORREST COUNTY. THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP AND SPREAD ACROSS SOUTHEAST MS INTO SOUTHWEST AL THIS MORNING...THOUGH OVERALL SEVERE THREAT APPEARS LIMITED AT THIS TIME. NEW WATCH ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY...THOUGH CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THE SOUTHERN EXTENT OF A COLD POOL ATTENDANT TO A LARGE AREA OF SHOWERS AND THUNDERSTORMS OVER MIDDLE TN TO SOUTHERN MS EXTENDED FROM CENTRAL AL TO WASHINGTON COUNTY AL TO WASHINGTON PARISH LA. A FEW STORMS IN VICINITY OF THIS BOUNDARY IN SOUTHEAST LA FROM 1030-12Z...FROM EAST FELICIANA PARISH TO WASHINGTON PARISH INDICATED STORM ROTATIONS PER TRENDS IN RADAR IMAGERY. THE DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT HAS BEEN GRADUALLY MOISTENING/DESTABILIZING WITH SURFACE DEW POINTS NOW IN THE MIDDLE TO UPPER 60S ACROSS SOUTHEAST MS AND FAR SOUTHWEST AL...RESULTING IN MUCAPE OF 500-1000 J/KG. DESPITE MODEST INSTABILITY...THE PRESENCE OF STRONG DEEP-LAYER AND LOW-LEVEL SHEAR /EFFECTIVE SHEAR OF 45-50 KT AND EFFECTIVE SRH EXCEEDING 400 M2/S2 PER 12Z SLIDELL SOUNDING/ SUGGESTS AN ISOLATED TORNADO AND/OR DAMAGING WIND THREAT CANNOT BE RULED OUT WITH EASTWARD EXTENT. THE STRONGEST STORM PER SLIDELL AND JACKSON RADAR DATA WAS LOCATED OVER MARION AND LAMAR COUNTIES IN SOUTHEAST MS...WITH THIS ACTIVITY LOCATED NEAR...OR MORE LIKELY NORTH OF...THE AFOREMENTIONED BOUNDARY ATTENDANT TO THE LARGER COLD POOL. LOW-LEVEL WAA ACROSS THIS REGION SHOULD BE THE PRIMARY FORCING MECHANISM FOR NEW STORM DEVELOPMENT... AS LARGER SCALE FORCING FOR ASCENT SPREADS TO THE NORTHEAST AWAY FROM THE DISCUSSION AREA WITH A LEAD SHORTWAVE TROUGH. THIS WOULD SUGGEST THE TORNADO THREAT MAY TEND TO BE LESS THAN WHAT WAS OBSERVED EARLIER THIS MORNING ACROSS SOUTHEAST LA WITH THE ISSUANCE OF WW 66.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT ALONG WITH A POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE WILL CONTINUE AS CELLS MOVE EWD ACROSS SRN AL AND INTO THE FAR WRN FL PANHANDLE THIS MORNING. A TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION SHORTLY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A SMALL CLUSTER OF STRONG THUNDERSTORMS WITH A SEVERE POTENTIAL...WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD INTO SRN AL OVER THE NEXT HOUR. AN AXIS OF INSTABILITY IS ANALYZED ACROSS SRN AL WHERE MLCAPE VALUES ARE ESTIMATED TO BE AROUND 500 J/KG. INSTABILITY MAY INCREASE THIS MORNING AS SFC HEATING TAKES PLACE. THIS COMBINED WITH 55 KT OF 0-6 KM SHEAR AND STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR EVIDENT ON THE MOBILE 88D-VWP SHOULD RESULT IN A CONTINUED TORNADO THREAT THIS MORNING. SUPERCELLS AND BOWING LINE SEGMENTS WILL ALSO HAVE A WIND DAMAGE THREAT AS WELL.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE AND MAY INCREASE ACROSS THE MID MS VALLEY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE THE PRIMARY THREATS LATE THIS MORNING BUT AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT MAY DEVELOP EARLY THIS AFTERNOON. WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SSWWD FROM CNTRL MO INTO THE ARKLATEX WITH A CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS NERN LA NNEWD INTO ERN AR. A FEW THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED ALONG THE WRN EDGE OF THE MOIST CORRIDOR WHERE SFC DEWPOINTS ARE IN THE MID 60S TO NEAR 70 F. AS SFC HEATING TAKES PLACE IN THE MID MS VALLEY OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...MODERATE INSTABILITY SHOULD DEVELOP ACROSS MOST OF ERN AR AND WRN TN. IN ADDITION...THE WSR-88D VWP AT MEMPHIS SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 50 KT WITH SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOW TO MID-LEVELS SUGGESTING THAT STORM ORGANIZATION WILL CONTINUE TO BE POSSIBLE LATE THIS MORNING. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS GRADUALLY MOVE THE CURRENT CONVECTION NEWD INTO FAR SE MO AND WRN TN OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE SWD ACROSS CNTRL ERN AR. DUE TO THE AMOUNT OF INSTABILITY AND STRONG DEEP-LAYER SHEAR...STORM MODE WILL FAVOR ISOLATED SUPERCELLS AND A FEW ORGANIZED LINE SEGMENTS. THE MAIN THREATS LATE THIS MORNING ARE EXPECTED TO BE WIND DAMAGE AND ISOLATED LARGE HAIL. A TORNADO THREAT MAY DEVELOP EARLY THIS AFTERNOON AS INSTABILITY INCREASES.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A LOW THREAT FOR OCCASIONALLY SEVERE HAIL WILL EXIST THROUGH ABOUT 18Z. DUE TO THE MARGINAL NATURE OF THE EXPECTED THREAT...WW ISSUANCE IS UNLIKELY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: CONVECTIVE ACTIVITY ACROSS FAR ERN IA INTO NWRN IL AND SWRN WI AS OF 1540Z IS ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH MOVING NEWD ACROSS THE UPPER MIDWEST THAT IS EMBEDDED WITHIN A LARGER SCALE POSITIVELY TILTED UPPER TROUGH ACROSS MUCH OF THE CNTRL/SWRN CONUS. AT THE SFC...A LOW IS ELONGATED FROM NE-SW ACROSS LOWER MI INTO NRN IL...WITH A COLD FRONT EXTENDING SWWD FROM THE LOW ACROSS THE IA/IL BORDER MOVING EWD. COLD TEMPERATURES ALOFT COMBINED WITH MODEST SFC HEATING AND SUFFICIENT LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ARE CONTRIBUTING TO WEAK INSTABILITY...WITH MUCAPE RANGING FROM 250-750 J/KG PER RAP MESOANALYSIS AND FORECAST SOUNDINGS. WITH SOME ADDITIONAL HEATING EXPECTED THROUGH THE MORNING HOURS...INSTABILITY MAY INCREASE SLIGHTLY THROUGH 18Z BEFORE THE COLD FRONT MOVES ACROSS THE MCD AREA. STRONG SWLY WINDS ALOFT ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHORTWAVE TROUGH AND EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR VALUES OF 40-50 KT SHOULD ALLOW SOME OF THE CONVECTION TO BECOME ORGANIZED AND POSE MAINLY AN ISOLATED LARGE HAIL RISK THROUGH 18Z. THE LACK OF A WARMER/MORE MOIST LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS SHOULD TEMPER THE DEGREE OF INSTABILITY AND RESULTING SEVERE RISK.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A TORNADO THREAT ALONG WITH A POTENTIAL FOR WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL CONTINUE LATE THIS MORNING ACROSS WW 67. THE THREATS ARE EXPECTED TO SPREAD EWD ACROSS SCNTRL AND SERN AL AND AFFECT THE WRN FL PANHANDLE OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED TO THE EAST OF WW 67.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST RADAR DATA SHOW A PERSISTENT CLUSTER OF STORMS IN SWRN AL WITH A COUPLE OF ROTATING CELLS ALONG THE LEADING EDGE. THE STORMS ARE LOCATED ALONG A CORRIDOR OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE WHERE SFC WINDS ARE LOCALLY MAXIMIZED. SOUTH OF THE CORRIDOR OVER THE LAST COUPLE OF HOURS...SFC DEWPOINTS HAVE INCREASED INTO THE MID 60S F AND SFC TEMPS HAVE WARMED INTO THE MID TO UPPER 70S F. AS A RESULT...WEAK INSTABILITY HAS DEVELOPED FROM SCNTRL AL SWD ACROSS PARTS OF THE WRN FL PANHANDLE. IN ADDITION...THE FORT RUCKER AL WSR-88D VWP SHOWS 0-6 KM SHEAR NEAR 60 KT WITH SUBSTANTIAL DIRECTIONAL SHEAR IN THE LOWEST 3 KM AGL. THIS IS CONTRIBUTING TO STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR WITH 0-3 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITY ESTIMATED AROUND 400 M2/S2. IN RESPONSE...THE TORNADO THREAT IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE INTO EARLY AFTERNOON AS THE CELLS MOVE ACROSS THE ERN PART OF WW 67. CONTINUED SFC HEATING AND INCREASING INSTABILITY ALONG WITH THE STRONG LOW-LEVEL SHEAR SHOULD ENABLE THE SEVERE THREAT TO BE MAINTAINED TO THE EAST OF WW 67. A POTENTIAL WILL EXIST FOR TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE ACROSS FAR SE AL AND THE WRN FL PANHANDLE...ESPECIALLY NEARER TO THE COAST WHERE ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE MAY BE NEEDED. ..BROYLES.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED SEVERE THREAT SHOULD DEVELOP OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE MAIN CONCERNS. WW ISSUANCE IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: THUNDERSTORMS WILL CONTINUE TO DEVELOP ALONG/JUST AHEAD OF A SFC COLD FRONT CURRENTLY LOCATED ACROSS PORTIONS OF CNTRL IL INTO FAR ERN MO AS OF 1730Z. THE LOW-LEVEL AIRMASS DOWNSTREAM OF THIS FRONT IS WEAKLY UNSTABLE...WITH WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS TEMPERING DIURNAL DESTABILIZATION SO FAR. BUT WITH CONTINUED NWD TRANSPORT OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE ACROSS SRN IL/WRN KY /CHARACTERIZED BY SFC DEWPOINTS IN THE LOWER 60S/...SOME INCREASE IN INSTABILITY SHOULD OCCUR THROUGH 19Z. A VEERING/STRENGTHENING WIND PROFILE NOTED ON THE 12Z KILX SOUNDING AS WELL AS RECENT VWPS FROM AREA RADARS SUGGESTS BULK SHEAR VALUES WILL EASILY SUPPORT SUPERCELL STRUCTURES INITIALLY...WITH LARGE HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS THE MAIN THREATS. EVENTUAL UPSCALE GROWTH INTO SHORT LINE SEGMENTS MAY OCCUR LATER THIS AFTERNOON/EARLY EVENING. THE TORNADO THREAT ACROSS THE MCD AREA SHOULD REMAIN LOW...BUT NOT ZERO...AS 0-1 KM WINDS TEND TO VEER SWLY WITH THE APPROACH OF THE COLD FRONT...LIMITING LOW-LEVEL SRH.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT WILL LIKELY DEVELOP FROM CNTRL AND NERN LA NEWD INTO CNTRL AND NRN MS. TORNADOES...WIND DAMAGE AND HAIL WILL BE POSSIBLE ACROSS PARTS OF CNTRL AND NRN MS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE WILL BE POSSIBLE SWWD ACROSS WRN MS INTO NERN AND CNTRL LA. WW ISSUANCE WILL LIKELY BE NEEDED ACROSS THE REGION THIS AFTERNOON.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS A DISTINCT CORRIDOR OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE LOCATED FROM ERN LA NNEWD ALONG THE MS RIVER INTO WRN TN. SFC DEWPOINTS ALONG THIS CORRIDOR RANGE FROM THE MID 60S TO THE LOWER 70S F AND MLCAPE IS ESTIMATED FROM NEAR 1500 J/KG IN NERN LA TO AROUND 750 J/KG IN NERN MS. OVER THE LAST HOUR...RADAR TRENDS SHOW CONVECTION TRYING TO INITIATE IN WRN MS BUT THIS PROCESS MAY TAKE AN HOUR OR SO. THE HRRR IS IN AGREEMENT WITH THIS THINKING...SUGGESTING THAT THUNDERSTORMS WILL DEVELOP IN NW MS AND NERN LA IN THE 19Z TO 20Z TIMEFRAME WITH A GRADUAL INCREASE IN CONVECTIVE COVERAGE LATE THIS AFTERNOON. REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS IN CNTRL AND NERN MS SHOW 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 60 KT WITH 0-3 KM STORM RELATIVE HELICITIES NEAR 350 M2/S2. THIS COMBINED WITH SFC SSELY FLOW ACROSS NERN MS WILL BE FAVORABLE FOR SUPERCELLS WITH TORNADOES AND WIND DAMAGE LATER THIS AFTERNOON. FURTHER TO THE SOUTHWEST ACROSS NERN LA AND WRN MS...SFC WINDS ARE GENERALLY FROM THE SOUTHWEST SUGGESTING THAT THE TORNADO THREAT WILL BE LESS. STILL...STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES AND STRONG DEEP LAYER SHEAR OVER NE LA AND WRN MS WILL FAVOR SUPERCELLS WITH ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE SEVERE THREAT ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF WW 67 AND LOCATIONS FURTHER E WILL PROBABLY REMAIN TOO ISOLATED TO WARRANT THE ISSUANCE OF A NEW WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED SUPERCELL WITH TRANSIENT LOW-LEVEL ROTATION HAS PROGRESSED EWD OVER SRN AL FOR THE PAST SEVERAL HOURS...PRODUCING SPORADIC HAIL/WIND REPORTS. THE AIRMASS TO THE E OF THIS ONGOING CONVECTION ACROSS SERN AL AND THE FAR WRN FL PANHANDLE IS SLIGHTLY LESS UNSTABLE COMPARED TO LOCATIONS FURTHER W...WITH SFC DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE MID 60S...AND THE LOW-LEVEL WIND FIELD ALSO WEAKENS WITH EWD EXTENT PER KMOB/KEVX/KTLH VWPS. IN ADDITION...LARGE-SCALE FORCING ASSOCIATED WITH A SHORTWAVE TROUGH OVER THE TN VALLEY IS BECOMING INCREASINGLY DISPLACED FROM THE ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS IN SRN AL. ALL OF THESE FACTORS SUGGEST THE OVERALL SEVERE THREAT IN ERN PORTIONS OF WW 67 AND FURTHER E SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED...AND WW 67 WILL PROBABLY BE ALLOWED TO EXPIRE AT 19Z AS SCHEDULED. ..GLEASON.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED DAMAGING WIND/LARGE HAIL RISK WILL CONTINUE ACROSS ERN PORTIONS OF WW 68. TORNADO THREAT INCREASING ACROSS PORTIONS OF SWRN TN...WITH NEW WW LIKELY SOON IN THIS REGION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TWO CLUSTERS OF THUNDERSTORMS HAVE POSED A DAMAGING WIND/LARGE HAIL RISK ACROSS ERN AR INTO WRN TN...AND ACROSS WRN KY. THE STRONGER CLUSTER IS CURRENTLY LOCATED ACROSS WRN TN WHERE INSTABILITY IS GREATER. THE CLUSTER ACROSS WRN KY WILL CONTINUE TO MOVE EWD INTO A LESS FAVORABLE THERMODYNAMIC ENVIRONMENT PER SFC OBSERVATIONS AND THE 18Z SOUNDING FROM KBNA. HOWEVER...VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY INDICATES SOME CLEARING ACROSS CNTRL KY AND MIDDLE TN...WHICH SHOULD ALLOW FOR SOME MODEST DOWNSTREAM DESTABILIZATION THROUGH MID TO LATE AFTERNOON. ACROSS SWRN TN...BACKED SFC WINDS NEAR A RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY COMBINED WITH STRONGER SFC HEATING AND MORE ROBUST LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE WILL SUPPORT AN INCREASING TORNADO THREAT...WITH A NEW WATCH LIKELY IN THIS REGION SOON. ..GLEASON.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A SEVERE THREAT MAY INCREASE ACROSS SE LA AND SRN MS OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS. ISOLATED LARGE HAIL AND WIND DAMAGE MAY OCCUR WITH THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS. THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD REMAIN ISOLATED AND WW ISSUANCE CAN NOT BE RULED OUT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SFC ANALYSIS SHOWS SLY FLOW ACROSS SE LA AND SRN MS WITH SFC DEWPOINTS GENERALLY IN THE LOWER TO MID 70S. THE MOIST AIRMASS IS CONTRIBUTING TO MLCAPE VALUES BETWEEN 1000 AND 1500 J/KG AS IS ESTIMATED BY MESOCALE ANALYSIS DATA. SCATTERED THUNDERSTORMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN THIS MODERATELY UNSTABLE AIRMASS FROM NORTH OF LAKE PONTCHARTRAIN NWD TO NEAR JACKSON MS ALONG THE AXIS OF THE STRONGEST LOW-LEVEL FLOW. IN ADDITION TO THE INSTABILITY...MODERATE DEEP-LAYER SHEAR IS PRESENT ACROSS THE MCD AREA ACCORDING TO REGIONAL WSR-88D VWPS. 0-6 KM SHEAR OF 40 TO 50 KT ALONG WITH THE INSTABILITY AND STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WILL MAKE SUPERCELLS WITH LARGE HAIL POSSIBLE. HOWEVER...WEAK LARGE-SCALE ASCENT WILL HELP KEEP MOST OF THE STORMS MULTICELLULAR. DUE TO THE MOIST AIRMASS...CELLS COULD ALSO PRODUCE WET DOWNBURSTS. SHORT-TERM MODEL FORECASTS SUGGEST THAT THE STRONGER THUNDERSTORMS WILL MOVE NEWD INTO WW 70.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEVERE RISK...WITH ALL HAZARDS POSSIBLE INCLUDING ISOLATED TORNADOES...WILL INCREASE OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS. WW ISSUANCE POSSIBLE IN THE SHORT TERM.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LINEAR CONVECTION IN SWRN TN CURRENTLY POSES MAINLY A DAMAGING WIND RISK AS IT PROGRESSES EWD AROUND 35-40 KT. THE AIRMASS ACROSS MUCH OF MIDDLE TN INTO NWRN AL IS WEAKLY UNSTABLE...WITH MLCAPE UP TO 500 J/KG PER RECENT RAP MESOANALYSIS. A RESIDUAL OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM PRIOR CONVECTION TO THE S OF THE MCD AREA HAS LIMITED MORE ROBUST MOISTURE RETURN SO FAR...AND WITH WIDESPREAD CLOUDINESS PRESENT PER VISIBLE SATELLITE IMAGERY...THE PROSPECT FOR ADDITIONAL DESTABILIZATION THIS AFTERNOON REMAINS LIMITED. REGARDLESS...STRONG EFFECTIVE BULK SHEAR AROUND 50 KT WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT STORM ORGANIZATION.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: RISK FOR LARGE HAIL AND A COUPLE TORNADOES WILL PERSIST WITHIN WW 70...AND LIKELY DEVELOP E INTO WRN AL THROUGH EVENING. A NEW TORNADO WATCH WILL LIKELY BE ISSUED DOWNSTREAM BY 23Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE CORRIDORS OF DISCRETE TO SEMI-DISCRETE CELLS ARE PRESENT WITHIN WW 70 MAINLY OVER PARTS OF CNTRL/SRN MS AND ALONG THE MS/TN BORDER. THIS ACTIVITY WILL POSE A PRIMARY THREAT OF LARGE HAIL AMID STRONG MID/UPPER SPEED SHEAR PER DGX VWP DATA. INCREASINGLY AGITATED CU/CB DEVELOPMENT IS UNDERWAY ACROSS E-CNTRL/NERN MS BETWEEN THE ONGOING TSTM CORRIDORS. WITH A REMNANT LARGE-SCALE OUTFLOW BOUNDARY EVIDENT FROM CNTRL AL INTO FAR NERN MS...LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPHS WILL BE COMPARATIVELY LARGER WITH ERN EXTENT GIVEN 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 200 M2/S2. MIXED CONVECTIVE MODES SUPPORTING ALL HAZARDS APPEAR POSSIBLE INTO WRN/CNTRL AL FOR SEVERAL HOURS THIS EVENING.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ONGOING THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS SRN IL INTO CNTRL IND MAY POSE A THREAT FOR STRONG WIND GUSTS AND PERHAPS A BRIEF TORNADO. ADDITIONAL THUNDERSTORMS MAY DEVELOP FARTHER S INTO FAR SERN MO AND WRN KY. A WW IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST VISIBLE SATELLITE AND LIGHTNING LOOPS SHOW A LINE OF TSTMS ALONG/AHEAD OF AN EWD MOVING COLD FRONT FROM SRN IL INTO CNTRL IND. AN INCREASING CU FIELD IS ALSO NOTED FARTHER S ALONG THE COLD FRONT INTO FAR SERN MO...WHERE FORCING FOR ASCENT ACCOMPANYING THE TRAILING PORTION OF A WELL-DEFINED UPPER VORT MAX IS OVERSPREADING THE REGION. MODEST AIR MASS RECOVERY HAS OCCURRED AHEAD OF THE LINE IN THE WAKE OF EARLIER CONVECTION...FEATURING A NARROW AXIS OF MLCAPE VALUES NEAR 1000 J/KG. A STRONG/SVR WIND GUST THREAT MAY ACCOMPANY ANY WELL-ORGANIZED BOWING SEGMENT THAT CAN EVOLVE. A BRIEF TORNADO CANNOT ALSO BE RULED OUT GIVEN THE STRENGTH OF LOW-LEVEL SHEAR PRESENT IN REGIONAL VWP DATA. CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED OVER THE NEXT HR FOR A POSSIBLE WW.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SEMI-DISCRETE SUPERCELLS PRODUCING LARGE HAIL SHOULD PERSIST FOR THE NEXT FEW HOURS BEFORE MAINLY SHIFTING INTO WW 70.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A COUPLE SUPERCELLS ACROSS NRN LA ARE BEING SUPPORTED BY STEEP MID-LEVEL LAPSE RATES WITHIN A PERSISTENT EML PLUME AND ROBUST MID/UPPER-LEVEL SPEED SHEAR PER POE/JAN VWP DATA. WHILE VEERED LOW-LEVEL FLOW AHEAD OF THE IMPINGING COLD FRONT SHOULD LIMIT THE TORNADO RISK...THE MOSTLY DISCRETE NATURE OF THE CONVECTION WILL CONTINUE TO SUPPORT A PRIMARY RISK OF LARGE HAIL. CURRENT CONVECTIVE TRENDS SUGGEST THE BULK OF THE SEVERE THREAT SHOULD SHIFT INTO WW 70 BY ABOUT 01Z. ..GRAMS.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: PRIMARY STRONG TO SVR WIND GUST THREAT WITHIN WW 71 IS ASSOCIATED WITH A SMALL LINE SEGMENT MOVING THROUGH S-CNTRL KY. THIS THREAT MAY EXTEND SLIGHTLY E OF WW 71 INTO SERN KY...BUT DRIER AIR ACROSS THIS AREA SHOULD LEAD TO A GENERAL REDUCTION IN TSTM INTENSITY WITH EWD PROGRESSION.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LONG-LIVED LINE SEGMENT CONTINUES TO PROGRESS EWD ACROSS S-CNTRL KY...WITH A PRIMARY THREAT OF STRONG TO SVR WIND GUSTS. THIS ACTIVITY IS RAPIDLY APPROACHING THE ERN EDGE OF WW 71...AND THE ACCOMPANYING WIND THREAT MAY EXTEND FARTHER E INTO PARTS OF SERN KY. HOWEVER...RECENT SFC OBS CONFIRM DRIER AIR IS PRESENT ACROSS THIS AREA WITH SFC DEW POINTS IN THE LOW-MID 50S F. GIVEN THE RELATIVELY LIMITED BUOYANCY HERE...THE WIND THREAT SHOULD BECOME MORE LOCALIZED WITH EWD PROGRESSION...AND A NEW DOWNSTREAM WW IS NOT ANTICIPATED. ..ROGERS.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: ALL SEVERE HAZARDS REMAIN POSSIBLE OVER THE NEXT SEVERAL HOURS...WITH THE LONGEST DURATION TORNADO RISK POTENTIALLY CENTERED ON NWRN/N-CNTRL AL AND EXTREME SRN TN.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: NUMEROUS CELLS ARE ONGOING FROM MIDDLE TN INTO SRN MS/AL. OVERALL CONVECTIVE MODE HAS EVOLVED INTO A MIX OF DISCRETE SUPERCELLS AND CLUSTERS. WHILE ALL SEVERE HAZARDS ARE POSSIBLE WITHIN THIS REGIME...RECENT VWP DATA AT BMX/HTX/MXX HAVE SAMPLED SOME BACKING AND STRENGTHENING OF WINDS AOB 1 KM AGL. THIS ENLARGEMENT TO THE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH IS YIELDING 0-1 KM SRH AROUND 250-300 M2/S2. WITH MIDDLE TO UPPER 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS HAVING OVERSPREAD ALL BUT NERN AL AS AN EARLIER LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW DECAYED...SETUP MAY SUPPORT A COMPARATIVELY LONGER DURATION TORNADO RISK ACROSS MOST OF NRN AL INTO LATE EVENING. ..GRAMS.. 03/31/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: THE RISK FOR ISOLATED DAMAGING WINDS AND A BRIEF TORNADO MAY PERSIST FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS...BUT OVERALL THREAT SHOULD REMAIN TOO LOCALIZED TO WARRANT A WW ISSUANCE AT THIS POINT.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A PERSISTENT CONVECTIVE COMPLEX HAS BEEN LONG-LIVED ALONG THE EDGE OF THE CAPE GRADIENT WITHIN A MODEST LOW-LEVEL WAA REGIME. 0-3 KM SHEAR IS MODERATE /AROUND 25 KT/ PER TLH VWP DATA...WHICH HAS GENERALLY SUPPORTED OUTFLOW-DOMINANT VELOCITY SIGNATURES AMID STRONGER DEEP SHEAR. DOWNSTREAM ENVIRONMENT REMAINS RELATIVELY DRY /LOW 60S SURFACE DEW POINTS/...SUGGESTING AREAL EXTENT OF ANY SEVERE RISK WILL BE CONFINED. BUT A CONTINUED FEED OF UPPER 60S TO LOWER 70S SURFACE DEW POINTS FROM THE NRN GULF SUGGESTS THE RISK FOR LOCALLY DAMAGING WINDS AND A BRIEF TORNADO WILL BE NON-NEGLIGIBLE DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WITH PERSISTENT SUPERCELLS APPROACHING THE EDGE OF WW 72 ALONG THE TN/AL BORDER AREA...A DOWNSTREAM WATCH ISSUANCE IS LIKELY PRIOR TO 02Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: 00Z BMX RAOB SAMPLED AN ADEQUATE TORNADIC SUPERCELL ENVIRONMENT WITH MLCAPE NEAR 1000 J/KG...0-1 SRH AROUND 200 M2/S2 AND EFFECTIVE SHEAR NEAR 50 KT. THE 65 DEG F ISODROSOTHERM IS ROUGHLY FROM NEAR HSV TO GAD AS OF 00Z. CONTINUED LOW-LEVEL WAA SHOULD RESULT IN SURFACE-BASED BUOYANCY BEING MAINTAINED INTO AT LEAST PARTS OF NRN GA. AS SUCH...ALL HAZARDS WILL BE POSSIBLE...BUT THE PREDOMINANT THREAT MAY BECOME DAMAGING WINDS GIVEN LIKELY CLUSTER/MCS MODE AND INCREASINGLY ELEVATED NATURE OF CONVECTION WITH NRN EXTENT.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: SVR THREAT WILL CONTINUE TO WANE THIS EVENING THROUGH WW 69 EXPIRATION TIME OF 03Z.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A LINE OF STRONG TSTMS CONTINUES TO ADVANCE SEWD ALONG/JUST AHEAD OF A COLD FRONT. LATEST RADAR TRENDS SHOW A FEW STRONGER CORES PERSISTING WITHIN THIS LINE THAT COULD FEATURE LOCALIZED MARGINALLY SVR HAIL. LIX AND LCH 00Z SOUNDINGS SAMPLED STEEP MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES AMIDST MODERATELY STRONG EFFECTIVE-LAYER SHEAR...WHICH COULD MAINTAIN A MARGINAL HAIL THREAT FOR THE NEXT 2-3 HRS...BUT THE LOSS OF DIURNAL HEATING COMBINED WITH AN UNFAVORABLE CONVECTIVE MODE WILL GENERALLY SUPPORT A DIMINISHING SVR THREAT THROUGH/BEYOND WATCH EXPIRATION TIME OF 03Z. ..ROGERS.. 04/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: A MARGINAL SEVERE HAIL RISK MAY PERSIST FOR A COUPLE MORE HOURS WITHIN REMAINING PORTIONS OF WW 70. AN ADDITIONAL WW ISSUANCE DOES NOT APPEAR NEEDED AFTER 03Z SCHEDULED EXPIRATION BUT A LOCAL EXTENSION IS POSSIBLE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LARGE-SCALE CONVECTIVE OUTFLOW IS DRAPED ACROSS CNTRL MS IN THE WAKE OF AN MCS THAT IS PREDOMINATELY WITHIN AL. ADDITIONAL STORMS HAVE PERSISTED ALONG THE MERGER OF THIS OUTFLOW AND CONVECTION AHEAD OF A SLOW-MOVING COLD FRONT. WHILE LOW-LEVEL WINDS ARE VEERED...DEEP-LAYER SPEED SHEAR REMAINS MODERATELY STRONG. WITH UPSTREAM 00Z RAOBS /LIX AND LCH/ SAMPLING 700-500 MB LAPSE RATES NEAR 8 DEG C/KM...THE RISK FOR MARGINALLY SEVERE HAIL MAY CONTINUE FOR AN HOUR OR SO BEYOND THE 03Z SCHEDULED WW EXPIRATION. ..GRAMS.. 04/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRANSIENT MESOCYCLONES SHOULD POSE A LOW-PROBABILITY TORNADO/WIND RISK DURING THE NEXT FEW HOURS AS AN MCS EVOLVES FROM PARTS OF AL/FAR SERN TN INTO WRN GA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: A MESSY CLUSTER CONVECTIVE MODE HAS BECOME PREDOMINANT WITH AN MCS GRADUALLY SHIFTING E FROM THE TN VALLEY. AREA VWP DATA HAVE SAMPLED STRENGTHENING LOW-LEVEL WINDS BUT INCREASINGLY VEERED FLOW /SWLYS/ AS WELL. OVER THE NEXT FEW HOURS...THE LOW-LEVEL HODOGRAPH SHOULD STILL REMAIN CONDUCIVE TO TRANSIENT MESOCYCLONES. WHERE SURFACE DEW POINTS ARE IN THE MIDDLE 60S OR GREATER...ROUGHLY BOUNDED TO THE EAST BY THE WRN ATLANTA METRO TO MACON AREA AS OF 03Z...A BRIEF TORNADO RISK WILL REMAIN PRESENT. IT APPEARS THIS MAY BECOME CONFINED TO MAINLY E-CNTRL AL/W-CNTRL GA GIVEN A COMPARATIVELY RICHER FEED OF LOW-LEVEL MOISTURE. FARTHER N ALONG THE TN/AL/GA BORDER...THE ABUNDANT OVERTURNING ALONG WITH A PINCHED-OFF SURFACE-BASED WARM SECTOR SUGGESTS THE TORNADO THREAT SHOULD SLOWLY WANE. ..GRAMS.. 04/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED FOR A WATCH. ISOLD DMGG WIND WOULD LIKELY BE THE PRIMARY THREAT WITH A LINEAR CONVECTIVE MODE.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: RADAR IMAGERY AT 0530Z SHOWS A MCV OVER FAR NRN GA WITH A BROKEN BOWING CONVECTIVE LINE FROM EXTREME NERN GA ARCING SWD TOWARDS AHN AND SWWD TO NEAR MCN. THE LOW CAPE/STRONG SHEAR SHEAR REGIME DENOTED BY OBJECTIVE ANALYSIS WILL LIKELY FAVOR STORM ORGANIZATION. SOME STRONGER STORMS MAY MANIFEST AN ISOLD WIND-DAMAGE RISK WITHIN THE CONVECTIVE LINE AS IT MOVES EWD BUT THIS THREAT WILL REMAIN RELATIVELY LIMITED GIVEN WEAK LOW-LEVEL LAPSE RATES. GIVEN THE WEAK BUOYANCY REGIME...IT REMAINS UNLIKELY SUPERCELL STRUCTURES WILL EVOLVE BUT TRENDS WILL BE MONITORED IF THIS SCENARIO WERE TO UNFOLD.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: AN ISOLATED RISK FOR DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS A TORNADO --ALBEIT LOW BUT NONZERO-- WILL SEEMINGLY EXIST OVERNIGHT AND DOWNSTREAM OF INTENSIFYING STORMS IN SWRN AND CNTRL AL INVOF A WEST-TO-EAST ORIENTED OUTFLOW BOUNDARY.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: SURFACE OBSERVATIONS OVER S-CNTRL AL INDICATE AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY FROM EARLIER ACTIVITY IN GA IS ORIENTED WEST TO EAST ACROSS S-CNTRL AL. TO THE SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY...LOWER 70S TEMPS AND UPPER 60S TO NEAR 70 DEG F DEWPOINTS INDICATE THE MARITIME AIRMASS IS SLOW TO STABILIZE ACROSS THE REGION. WHILE IT SEEMS ONLY ISOLATED/LOCALIZED WIND DAMAGE/SMALL HAIL ARE THE THREATS WITH A STRONGER STORM OR TWO AT THIS TIME...STORM ORGANIZATION AND FURTHER INTENSIFICATION ARE POSSIBLE. GIVEN THE STRONG TROPOSPHERIC FLOW ACROSS THE DISCUSSION AREA /REFERENCE KMXX VAD DATA/...THE CONSIDERATION FOR AN ADDITIONAL WATCH MAY BE NEEDED IF STORM INTENSIFICATION TRENDS CONTINUE.

mesoscale_discussions.summary: WIDELY SCATTERED TO LOCALLY SCATTERED TSTMS MAY PRODUCE SPORADIC LARGE HAIL OVER DISCUSSION AREA THRU PRE-DAWN HOURS. THREAT APPEARS TOO MRGL/DISORGANIZED FOR WW.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: TSTMS HAVE DEVELOPED IN TWO MAIN/BKN BANDS BETWEEN DRT/T82 LINE AND TX COASTAL BEND...WITH OTHER CONVECTIVE INITIATION POSSIBLE DURING NEXT FEW HOURS N OF SLOW-MOVING SFC COLD FRONT. ACTIVITY SHOULD SPREAD NEWD AND WEAKEN WITH ADDITIONAL DEVELOPMENT POSSIBLE CLOSER TO SFC FRONT. AT 07Z THAT FRONT WAS ANALYZED FROM SRN HOU METRO AREA SWWD TO NEAR NOG AND JUST S LRD. FRONT SHOULD CONTINUE TO DRIFT SWD WHILE OVERTOPPED BY BROAD...SELY-SSELY...30-40 KT LLJ WRAPPING AROUND E RIM OF DEVELOPING 850-MB LOW NEAR DRT. ELEVATED MOISTURE TRANSPORT AND WAA WILL CONTINUE N OF FRONT...SUPPORTING ISENTROPIC ASCENT OF PARCELS TO LFC AMIDST STEEP/EML-GENERATED MIDLEVEL LAPSE RATES. ELEVATED MUCAPE 1000-1500 J/KG IS EXPECTED TO PERSIST JUST N OF SFC FRONT...DECREASING NWD TO LESS THAN 500 J/KG OVER HILL COUNTRY... AMIDST 50-70 KT EFFECTIVE-SHEAR MAGNITUDES. THIS WILL SUPPORT SPORADIC ORGANIZATION OF CELLS OFFERING POTENTIAL FOR LARGE HAIL. SVR THREAT WILL BE LIMITED BY LACK OF GREATER BUOYANCY...AND BY DRY AIR IN LOWER PARTS OF STORM-INFLOW LAYER THAT MAY IMPEDE BOTH LIQUID-WATER CONTENT AND UPDRAFT MAINTENANCE MORE THAN INDICATED BY MOST-UNSTABLE ELEVATED LIFTED PARCELS ON FCST SOUNDINGS. ..EDWARDS.. 04/01/2016 ...PLEASE SEE WWW.SPC.NOAA.GOV FOR GRAPHIC PRODUCT...

mesoscale_discussions.summary: CONTINUING TO MONITOR SHORT-TERM TRENDS FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF A NEW TORNADO WATCH ACROSS SERN AL EWD INTO S-CNTRL GA.
mesoscale_discussions.discussion: LATEST SURFACE OBSERVATIONS SHOW VERY MOIST LOW LEVELS --DEWPOINTS AOA 70 DEG F-- WITH STREAMLINE ANALYSIS INDICATING WINDS ARE SOUTHERLY TO THE SOUTH OF AN OUTFLOW BOUNDARY AROUND CSG TO MCN. THE RELATIVELY BACKED FLOW AT THE SURFACE IS ACTING TO ENLARGE THE LOW-LEVEL CURVATURE IN THE HODOGRAPH /REFERENCE KEOX VAD/. SINCE 09Z...ECHO TOPS HAVE INCREASED WITH THE CELLULAR CONVECTION WITHIN A BROKEN BAND OF STORMS ACROSS S-CNTRL AL. GIVEN THIS TREND IN RADAR IMAGERY...THIS LIKELY IMPLIES UPDRAFT INTENSITY IS INCREASING AND A CELLULAR MODE WOULD FAVOR AT LEAST SOME CONCERN FOR SUPERCELL MESOCYCLONE DEVELOPMENT. IF SUPERCELL STRUCTURES EVOLVE OR APPEAR IMMINENT...THE MODERATELY HIGH SRH ENVIRONMENT WOULD LIKELY ACCENTUATE POTENTIAL FOR A CONDITIONAL SUPERCELL-TORNADO RISK. IN SUMMARY...CONVECTIVE TRENDS WILL CONTINUE TO MONITORED EARLY THIS MORNING FOR THE POSSIBILITY OF ADDITIONAL STORM ORGANIZATION/STRENGTHENING.
